name: Beyond the Fairy Tale: a Dialogue with the Stars
source:
Let alone the flowers she had in her hair, the mysterious lady Prince Henri fell in love with only left a strange glass slipper behind her, on the stairs. Unable to go back to a judgmental and intrusive ballroom, the Prince was left with the memory of the fairy tale he saw in his ladylove's eyes...

At the same time, a young girl named Annelise, alone in the woods, was thinking of the royal ball she just attended, and of the royal prince she just danced with. However, she also was sensitive to the Prince's melancholy, and started to wonder what the cause could be.

But a star, shining in the sky, could be the answer to go beyond the fairy tale and find their respective truths...

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/beyond-the-fairy-tale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
让亨利王子爱上的神秘女子只在楼梯上留下了一只奇异的水晶鞋，连发间的花也没有留下。王子不愿回到那处处遭人评判、事事被人干涉的舞厅，只能回味在心上人眼中看见的童话…

与此同时，名叫安妮莉丝的女孩独自待在林中，想起刚刚参加的宫廷舞会，也想起了与自己共舞的王子。她还感受到了王子心头的忧郁，不禁猜想那是从何而来。

也许，天上闪耀的一颗星，能带他们走出童话，找到各自的真相…

〔摘自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/beyond-the-fairy-tale]itch.io[/url]〕
